svg.title: Argus: Keeps PyTorch training alive across EC2 Spot reclaims: predict, checkpoint, migrate, resume.
svg.desc: Argus project card. Role: co-author · ml layer. Key results: ~75 s resume after a real Spot drain on EKS; 152 real reclaims labelled by a sensor fleet; 1.14× vs 1.34× slowdown vs Young-Daly, 300 s ckpt.
